reviews.title: Great cooler for the price.
reviews.comment: Very quiet, incredibly easy to install, massive upgrade from air cooling and performs very well plus you just can't beat the price. I would recommend using better thermal paste than what's included.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great cooling, outperforms competition that costs twice as much!
reviews.comment: This thing is amazing. For such a low price I wasn't expecting much but it blew me away! It's exactly the advertised size, fit perfectly exhausting out the top of my HAF X full tower case, and the RGP is beautiful. It keeps my 5800X3D idling at just 21C over ambient and peaking at a cool 68C under a heavy sustained 100% load in benchmarks.
reviews.author: Kindle Customer

reviews.title: Extremely Quality Option
reviews.comment: It was relatively easy to install once I actually read the instructions. It seems to work well. I’m not sure about where it’s supposed to be but it keeps it around 45* C for my 7800x3d. The color looks really good and the branding is kept to a minimal and fits right into my build. This is the best choice for anyone looking for a high quality option for a low price.
reviews.author: CN

reviews.title: Very efficient and minimalist cooler. No software needed!
reviews.comment: I own a Gaming PC repair shop in Vegas. I change about 2 coolers a week, if not 3. I have been using this for my customers who do not want any fancy screens but just performance. This cooler delivers every time. What makes this cooler so special,l other than its performance, is that it needs no software of any kind. Simple, no-nonsense setup. No USB header needed. Also, the ARGB and the cooling fans can be daisy-chained to each other. All you need is a CPU fan header and a PUMP header. That is it. Unlike brands like Corsair, which makes you install their software, this just runs off the speed setup in the BIOS. Very quiet. All this at this crazy low price? Buy it, you would love it.
